name: vscode-extension-host
description: A language-neutral VS Code host API for workspace plugins and live diagnostics.

scripts.package:vsix: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && vsce package --no-dependencies --out dist/vscode-extension-host.vsix

vscodeExtensionHost.workspaceSetupScript.description: Workspace-relative JavaScript setup script run silently in trusted workspaces.

vscodeExtensionHost.workspaceSetupWatch.description: Workspace-relative file patterns that rerun the workspace setup script when changed.
